questions.quote: Do you know why is it bubbling when water is boiled? Solubility of gases in liquid decrease with increase in temperature. Generally, water contains dissolved oxygen. When water is heated, the solubility of oxygen in water decreases, so oxygen escapes in the form of bubbles.

en.q: The bubbles seen when water is heated, before boiling, are mainly due to
options: dissolved oxygen escaping as its solubility decreases
en.explanation: The solubility of gases in liquids decreases with a rise in temperature.

en.explanation: An unsaturated solution contains less solute than the saturated one.

questions.quote: Points to Remember: In endothermic process, solubility of solid solute increases with increase in temperature. In exothermic process, solubility of solid solute decreases with increase in temperature.

en.q:
Consider the following statements:
(i) In an endothermic dissolution, solubility of a solid solute increases with a rise in temperature.
(ii) In an exothermic dissolution, solubility of a solid solute decreases with a rise in temperature.
(iii) Polar compounds dissolve in non-polar solvents.
Which are correct?
en.explanation: Polar compounds are soluble in polar solvents and non-polar compounds in non-polar solvents.

ta.q:
பின்வரும் கூற்றுகளைக் கருதுக:
(i) வெப்பம் கொள் கரைதலில் வெப்பநிலை உயரும்போது திண்மக் கரைபொருளின் கரைதிறன் அதிகரிக்கும்.
(ii) வெப்பம் உமிழ் கரைதலில் வெப்பநிலை உயரும்போது திண்மக் கரைபொருளின் கரைதிறன் குறையும்.
(iii) முனைவுறும் சேர்மங்கள் முனைவுறாக் கரைப்பான்களில் கரையும்.
சரியானவை எவை?
ta.explanation: முனைவுறும் சேர்மங்கள் முனைவுறும் கரைப்பான்களிலும், முனைவுறாச் சேர்மங்கள் முனைவுறாக் கரைப்பான்களிலும் கரையும்.

questions.quote: Hygroscopic substances are used as drying agents. Deliquescent substances lose their crystalline shape and ultimately dissolve in the absorbed water forming a saturated solution.

en.explanation: Deliquescent substances lose their crystalline shape and dissolve in the absorbed water.
